# Zhou-Geng Xu (徐洲更)

> Postdoctoral fellow in Jia-Wei Wang's lab at the CAS Center for Excellence in Molecular Plant Sciences (CEMPS). Plant single-cell sequencing and cross-species cell atlases.

Zhou-Geng Xu is the same person as 徐洲更, Zhougeng Xu, and the GitHub user xuzhougeng. ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7682-3482
